text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey Yukino, do you braid your hair 
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes~! Looking at the magazine, I learned 
how to do both Dutch braids and French 
braids~! Ah, this one is a Dutch braid.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You really are good at this... The 
stitches are so even. And it goes so well 
with the ribbon. It's super cute.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? C-Cute...? Oh, City-san, you're such 
a flatterer~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say stuff like this just to 
flatter you. I mean every word of it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, could you do me a favor next time? A 
braided headband.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaaat!? I-I-I'm supposed to do 
City-san's hair!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hawaa~, b-but I couldn't possibly... 
City-san's hair is so shiny, pretty, and 
clean—just looking at it already makes my 
day, so touching it would be...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...It's my precious hair. I'd rather leave 
it to the dexterous Yukino, wouldn't I?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright! In that case, I'm gonna give it 
everythin' I've got! L-Leave it to meee!
